text: Sunny, top-floor 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom TIC in the vibrant Mission District! Completely remodeled, this 970 sq. ft. home features a modern, open-concept living area and beautifully appointed eat-in kitchen with Silestone quartz countertops, panel-ready appliances, and a sleek black stainless-steel range. Additional highlights include an in-unit LG washer and dryer and secure, dedicated storage space. Enjoy a beautifully landscaped, shared backyard featuring a grill and smoker provided by the HOAperfect for outdoor dining, entertaining, and relaxing. HOA dues $505/month.

Modern architecture, beautiful scale and effortless indoor-outdoor living come together at 200 Putnam, a recently remodeled Bernal Heights home just two blocks from the restaurants, cafs and shops of Cortland Avenue. From the moment you step inside, the home feels special. Soaring ceilings and walls of windows flood the main living space with natural light, while newly installed wide-plank engineered white oak hardwood floors add warmth and a polished, contemporary feel throughout. The open living, dining and kitchen spaces flow together beautifully equally suited to a quiet morning coffee, an intimate dinner or a house full of friends. Open the doors to the rear patio and let dinner spill outside for grilling and cocktails on a warm Bernal evening. Thoughtfully arranged across multiple levels, the home offers the rare luxury of both openness and separation. Four bedrooms create flexibility for family, overnight guests or a dedicated home office, while the upper-level lounge feels like a retreat of its own curl up with a book, put on a movie or simply settle in and unwind at the end of the day. And then there's the roof deck. Perched above it all with open southern outlooks, it may quickly become your feature of the house. Gather around the firepit with a glass of wine as the sun goes down, host friends for an evening under the stars, or steal a quiet moment above the city with your morning coffee. Multiple outdoor spaces make the home feel even more expansive, while an attached two-car garage, generous storage and dedicated laundry add the everyday conveniences that make city living easy. Outside your door, some of Bernal's best neighborhood spots are just a couple of blocks away along Cortland Avenue, with the Tompkins Stairway Garden, neighborhood parks and Alemany Farmers' Market nearby. And when it's time to leave the neighborhood, easy access to 101 and 280 makes commuting downtown or heading south remarkably convenient. Freshly remodeled yet warm and inviting, 200 Putnam delivers the space, style and outdoor living of a modern luxury home with the charm and energy that make Bernal Heights such a beloved San Francisco neighborhood.

text: Unit A at The Dandelion House is the lower flat of a vacant two-unit Victorian in the heart of Bernal Heights, where 1900 character meets thoughtful contemporary updates. A hand-painted dandelion blooms across the facade, a fitting welcome to an airy, light-filled flat with lofty ceilings, hardwood floors, dual-pane windows, and central heat. The flat offers two bedrooms, one bath, and an updated kitchen that opens to a terrace lounge, a serene spot for morning coffee or evenings outdoors. The unit includes one parking space and generous shared storage in the full basement, along with its own washer and dryer in a shared laundry room. The Mission and Noe Valley are just minutes away, with easy access to commuter shuttles, SFO, and the South Bay. Two-unit buildings may qualify for San Francisco's fast-track condo conversion, offering a potential path from TIC to condominium ownership (buyer to investigate). Offered as a TIC interest. The upper flat (Unit B) and the entire building are also offered separately.

Coveted North Slope of Bernal Heights. Turnkey 1890s Victorian with Twin Peaks and St. Paul's Church views, sun-drenched California native garden, Cortland Avenue steps away. Period character without the project: high ceilings, original mantel, penny tile and clawfoot tub, big eat-in kitchen, sunny workspace, four bedrooms and two full baths. Remote-work friendly, AT&T Fiber available. Out back, drought-tolerant California native landscaping with irrigation system and a covered deck with Sutro Tower view. Two-car side-by-side garage, EV charger, bonus room for gym, studio, or den. Walk out for espresso, dinner, or a drink on Cortland, then hike up to Bernal Heights Park. One block to Mission Street, tech shuttle stops nearby, easy access to 280.

One-of-a-kind, architecturally stunning home in a desirable location in Bernal Heights. This house is sophisticated, artistic, and comfortable at the same time. Thoughtfully designed with curated spaces. It offers a wonderful, flexible layout that is great for entertaining, hosting, and working from home. The main level features higher ceilings than most homes in San Francisco, which provide an airy and spacious feeling. The front rooms are visually dramatic. There are tall windows and a gas fireplace. The stylish bathroom is bright and gorgeous. The huge open kitchen, dining area, and sitting area are impressive and unique. There is a large island, beautiful counters and cabinets, chic lighting, skylights, and soaring ceilings. The other bathroom on this level is next to the rear bedroom. This bedroom looks out to a lemon tree and has a view of the Bay and the East Bay hills. The lower level offers another suite with a walk-in closet and a big bathroom. This unique bathroom features a 2 person shower and double-sink vanity. A lounge and office area opens to the backyard. The inviting, cozy yard has a hot tub, gas fire pit, and lemon tree. Interior access through the laundry room to the garage which has space for 2 car side-by-side parking. Nice natural light, handsome floors, designer light fixtures, and period details. Solar panels on the roof. Enjoy being near the numerous popular restaurants, cafes, bars, and shops along Cortland Ave. Just blocks from the trails of beloved Bernal Heights Park - one of the most scenic places in San Francisco. Quick access to 101 and 280. Bernal Heights is cherished for its weather, community, walkability, and proximity to other great neighborhoods. This is the special home that you've been waiting for.

Big Views in Bernal Heights. Expansive views and a flexible, light-filled floor plan define this contemporary Bernal Heights home. The main level features soaring ceilings and skylights and an open living and dining area framed by dramatic Bay views, along with a well-appointed entertainer's kitchen. The spacious primary suite offers a walk-in closet, private balcony and ensuite bath with double vanity, radiant heated floors and spa-style shower. On the lower level, two well-proportioned bedrooms share a full hall bath, while an additional flexible room works beautifully as a fourth bedroom, office or media room and opens directly to the rear deck and tiered garden with Bay views and a soaking hot tub. Recent updates include fresh interior and exterior paint, refreshed wood floors, new carpeting in select areas and select updated light fixtures. Separate laundry room, oversized garage with EV charger, driveway parking, solar panels and tankless water heater. Convenient to Bernal Village, parks, transit and 101/280.

Transparently priced Bernal Heights Oasis: Walking distance to restaurants, parks, and Cortland Ave shopping. Welcome to this extensively remodeled and expanded 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home on two levels, offering seamless access to tech shuttles, Highways 101/280, and Glen Park BART. The main level features an open gourmet kitchen with quartz countertops and premium Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances. The living and dining areas flow past a cozy fireplace to two large bedrooms with integrated WFH study nooks. Both bedrooms open directly to a custom Belgian bioclimatic pergola boasting glass walls, motorized shades, a power-louvered roof, custom lighting, and heaterscreating a private, all-weather sanctuary. The fully permitted lower level features a spacious primary suite with a walk-in closet, a fireplace, and a luxury en-suite bath with a Toto bidet. An adjoining bonus room/home office features large picture windows looking out to the yard. A functional entry drop-zone, laundry, and an attached garage with custom storage and driveway parking complete this level. The sun-drenched, west-facing rear garden is a completely private oasis bordering St. Mary's Park. It features hardscape pavers, automated irrigation, a built-in gas fire pit and BBQ, a variety of mature fruit trees (including avocado, lime, and pear). Down-to-the-studs remodel & expansion. Tech-forward: CAT 6 wiring, POE security cameras, and integrated Sonos speakers Premium finishes: Hunter Douglas automated shades and abundant natural light This turnkey property perfectly balances a quiet urban retreat with immediate proximity to Holly Park, Bernal Hill, and Peninsula commute corridors. Video & Matterport virtual tours available.

One-of-a-Kind Custom Home! A truly unique opportunity to own a one-of-a-kind custom-built residence in San Francisco's desirable Bernal Heights neighborhood. Thoughtfully designed with distinctive architectural details, generous living spaces, and a contemporary floor plan, 75 Bronte Street offers the character and individuality rarely found in today's market. This custom residence was created with an emphasis on modern living, natural light, indoor-outdoor flow, and flexible spaces that can accommodate a variety of lifestyles. From its custom design and finishes to its exceptional use of space, this is a property that stands apart from typical San Francisco homes. Important Disclosure: Certain building permits and/or final inspections associated with the construction remain open and must be completed and finalized with the appropriate City of San Francisco departments in order to obtain the final Certificate of Occupancy/Completion. Buyer is encouraged to independently investigate the permit history, current status of all permits, outstanding requirements, and the process and costs necessary to obtain final approvals to their satisfaction. A rare opportunity for a buyer seeking a distinctive custom San Francisco residence with the ability to complete the final permitting process and make this exceptional property their own.

How often does a warm and inviting home featuring 4-bedrooms AND 4.5-baths come onto the market in San Francisco? What about a wonderfully well-kept home that offers THREE en suites, plus a separate 1-bedroom, 1-bath bonus living area downstairs? Exactly. It's a rarity! This thoughtfully designed home includes an abundance of extras: attractive kitchen and bathroom updates, cozy gas fireplace, a family entertainment room with multipurpose bar, central vacuum system, and upscale Valet Custom Cabinet built-ins throughout. You'll love the light that streams in through the San Francisco Shutters stylishly dressed windows, illuminating the upstairs with its radiant glow. Speaking of energy, elevate your outdoor entertainment repertoire and invite guests to spill out from the kitchen and dining rooms onto the spacious rear deck and down to the beautifully landscaped yard enhanced by its water feature and high-end year-round turf. The nice, finished garage offers even more room to expand with its epoxy floors and generous bank of custom cabinets, workbench, and filing cabinets designed to house all of your personal and business supplies, hobby and workout gear. Still on the fence? Consider Bernal Height's countless "location, location" advantages! Tenant occupied. Please do not disturb.
